agents.description: Designs modules that hide a lot of behaviour behind a small interface, and decides where the seam belongs before any code moves.
agents.name: Deep Module Designer

agents.description: Sharpens the words a project uses while the work is happening, keeps the glossary honest, and records the decisions people will forget.
agents.name: Domain Modeller

agents.description: Charts work too large for one session as a map of decision tickets, then resolves them one at a time until the route is clear.
agents.name: Decision Wayfinder

agents.description: Interviews you round by round until every decision behind a plan is settled, recommending an answer to each question instead of only asking it.
agents.name: Design Interviewer

agents.description: Re-pitches an explanation that did not land, in short controlled sentences and the project's own agreed vocabulary.
agents.name: Plain Language Explainer

agents.description: Turns a question you cannot answer alone into a written questionnaire aimed at the one person who holds the missing knowledge.
agents.name: Questionnaire Author

agents.description: Runs a workspace that teaches one topic across many sessions: a stated mission, short lessons, reference sheets and a record of what stuck.
agents.name: Learning Coach

agents.description: Compacts a long working session into a handoff a fresh worker can pick up, pointing at the existing artifacts instead of copying them.
agents.name: Handoff Writer

agents.description: Writes and prunes the documents an automated worker reads, so the same process runs every time instead of being a coin flip.
agents.name: Agent Instruction Writer

agents.description: Interviews you for raw material and files every usable fragment, refusing to impose a structure before the pile is worth shaping.
agents.name: Fragment Miner

agents.description: Turns a pile of raw material into an article one block at a time, grounding every idea before a later block leans on it.
agents.name: Article Shaper

agents.description: Builds a piece one beat at a time, offering two or three reachable next moves at each step and writing only the one you pick.
agents.name: Beat Sequencer

description: Twelve agents and three teams for the craft around building software rather than the building itself: deep module design, domain vocabulary and written decisions, mapping work too large for one session, and the thinking-partner and writing slice that small teams lean on hardest. Adapted from the MIT-licensed repository mattpocock/skills: every body was rewritten from scratch into the Clawboo document set, the units that duplicate agents already in the catalog were dropped, and the teams, routing, skills, categories and colours are Clawboo's.
name: Engineering Craft

skills.description: Records a hard-to-reverse decision as one short numbered document: the context, the choice made, and the reason a future reader will look for.
skills.name: ADR Writing

skills.description: Keeps one agreed word per idea in a project glossary, names the words it rules out, and holds no implementation detail at all.
skills.name: Domain Glossary

skills.description: Puts a whole round of numbered questions to a person, each carrying a recommended answer, then waits before opening the next round.
skills.name: Interview Grilling

skills.description: Writes a discovery questionnaire aimed at the gap between what a recipient knows and what the sender needs, ordered most important first.
skills.name: Questionnaire Authoring

skills.description: Runs a stateful teaching workspace: a stated mission, short sourced lessons, reference sheets, and a numbered record of what has landed.
skills.name: Teaching Loop

skills.description: Compacts a working session into a handoff that points at the artifacts already holding the detail, with sensitive values removed.
skills.name: Session Handoff

skills.description: Designs a module interface more than once, compares the alternatives on depth, locality and seam placement, then recommends one.
skills.name: Deep Module Design

teams.description: Settles the vocabulary, stress-tests the open decisions, and designs the module interfaces before any of it is committed to code.
teams.name: Codebase Design Studio

teams.description: Takes a piece from an empty page to a finished draft: mine the fragments, choose a shape, then make every sentence land.
teams.name: Writing Room

teams.description: Works a decision nobody can make in one sitting: map it, grill it, ask the person who knows, and hand the remainder on cleanly.
teams.name: Decision Desk
